posts.text:
This is huge. 

But may we remember:

Big or small, there is so much power in an unexpected act of kindness.

Amidst the hustle and hurry of our lives, may we look for opportunities to embody this spirit of grace.

To notice.
To reach out.
To lend a hand.

A small act to us can mean the world to someone else.

Op: @cbsnews

Small acts of kindness.
Everyday moments of grace.
The gentle power of a good deed.

Our media may overlook it.
Our algorithms may not amplify it.
But our world is full of this spirit.

See it.
Celebrate it.
Be it.

The quality of mercy is not strain'd.
It droppeth as the gentle rain from heaven
Upon the place beneath. It is twice blest:

Op: @spreadlovemovement_

There is so much power in kindness.

No judgment.
No looking down on others.
No questions asked.

Just an act of grace.
And another.
And another.

Until, perhaps, kindness wears down the stubborn walls of cynicism and reminds us that, despite the loud clang of meanness that captures so much attention, there is still so much goodness in this world.

May we choose kindness.
May we be part of the proof.
